what: audio heads (first 4800 output samples) of upstream renders, for T3 checks on the beginning of a render
format: head: float32 samples as shortest round-trip decimals (parse as f64, convert to float32: bit-exact); peaks: f64 repr of the f32 value
tolerance: T3: max|delta| <= 1e-6 x peak of the reference samples compared
